meta.label: Demo assessment — shortened for prototype evaluation
meta.notice: This is a shortened, prototype instrument built on the structure of Holland's RIASEC model. It has NOT been psychometrically validated and must not be presented as a validated RIASEC assessment.

interest.text: I would rather fix or build something with my hands than read about how it works.
I enjoy working with tools, machines, or physical materials.
When something breaks, I want to understand why before I try to fix it.
I enjoy digging into data or evidence to work out what is really going on.
I often come up with my own ideas rather than following an existing example.
I enjoy designing, drawing, writing, composing, or making things look and feel right.
People come to me when they need help or need something explained.
I find it satisfying to teach someone until they genuinely understand.
I am comfortable persuading people or leading a group towards a decision.
I like starting things — projects, clubs, small businesses — rather than joining them.
I prefer clear instructions and a tidy system over figuring it out as I go.
I am good at keeping records, schedules, or numbers accurate and organised.

context.text: Describe one thing you made, fixed, organised, or helped with that you were proud of.
